title: Email Works Too
status: rendered to Production Handoff standards (proof-of-concept tier)
objective: Encourage the first account placement from signed-but-inactive clients.
activation_barrier: 'Do I have to log into a portal? That sounds like a hassle.'
core_message: Getting your accounts to SWRS is easier than you think.

engine_mapping.fix: skip the portal — email works too

distribution: Day-21 slot of the activation drip; auto-stops on first placement.

production.style: polished modern 3D animated commercial, cohesive cool-blue SWRS palette

swrs_portal.source: https://www.swrsportal.com/ (real SWRS Client Portal login page, screenshotted 2026-08-04)
swrs_portal.use: shown on Victor's laptop screen in Scene 1

swrs_logo_white.source: official 'SWRS logo final white.png' (verified sha256-identical to video_factory/brand/logo/swrs_logo_final_white.png)
swrs_logo_white.use: animated logo reveal: fades in top-center (520px wide, soft drop shadow) at t=15.6s over the closing scene and holds through the brand card

production.audio_mix: standard DUCKING mix: scene SFX full in scenes 1-2, ducks to 0.22x during the scene-3 narration window, recovers; VO 1.25x; amix normalize=0 + alimiter 0.95.

voiceover.line: No login. No portal. No problem. Email works too. Just send your accounts to info@swrecovery.com.
voiceover.spoken_as: email read as 'info at S-W Recovery dot com'

production.logo_animation: official white SWRS logo (media 38707f0b) fades in top-center over the last ~2.5s of scene 3 and holds through the brand card; 520px wide, alpha fade 0.9s from t=15.6s, soft drop shadow for legibility. This is the standard logo reveal for all future episodes.
